capture.state: Explicit 16:9; compiled Options defaults; no GPU SDK capabilities; no saved options; no game
capture.method: Compiles and calls the maintained development menu draw_menu function, its ImGui sources and translation code. No game, Vulkan device, window or game-derived assets; fonts loaded only from third_party/fonts/libertinus.

review.font_source: Bundled Libertinus Sans Regular/Bold and Serif Semibold; third_party/fonts/libertinus/OFL.txt.
review.notes: Recaptured for fullscreen monitor PR #1277 from clean 54d25c79 with the maintained game-free menu fixture, bundled ImGui/Libertinus and SDL software rendering. The final first-view Graphics capture, Quality preset help, labels and navigation were visually compared with the previous a06f7e2e illustration; the current source revision and scrollbar are recorded rather than relabeling the older capture. Fullscreen monitor is below this view in Screen, demonstrated by a separate same-position before/after PR pair. Compiler-discovered dependency provenance includes monitor_choice.h; no game, live monitor probe, save, private path or game-derived asset is used. Fixture-only graphics-screen mode does not alter this standard graphics view. Retained after rebase onto 8e9cfc3a, reviewed at 0aa01320: dependency discovery adds or removes no inputs. Changes are the appended main-thread timing/ABI declarations, optional DLSS CNN model choices below the captured view, and an Intel compiler hint outside the view. The maintained default Graphics/Screen rows, illustrated values and help are unchanged. No new rendering is claimed; captured_source, game_version, PNG and original fixture hashes retain their actual identities. Retained after rebase onto f88e6e3a: preprocessing adds only vk_new.h, with no removed dependency. The ABI 29 header preserves upstream out_of_memory before monitor callbacks; vk_internal.h adds allocation-handler declarations; vk_recorder.h and vk_new.h guard nothrow allocations. These inputs do not change the illustrated menu controls or help. No new rendering is claimed; original capture, fixture and PNG identities remain unchanged.
